breakdown.description: Fanning friction factor is used directly in the Darcy–Weisbach equation without converting to Darcy friction factor.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the Fanning friction factor f = 0.005 directly in the Darcy–Weisbach equation without converting it to the Darcy friction factor (f_D = 4 × 0.005 = 0.02). This repeats the original error. The ground truth requires explicit conversion from Fanning to Darcy friction factor before applying the equation.
